title: quality: add missing security headers to _headers file
body:
Found by daily quality sweep on 2026-03-01.

**Source**: CodeRabbit
**Severity**: medium
**Files affected**: `_headers`

**Finding**: The `_headers` file only contains cache control directives. Critical security headers are missing (e.g., Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy).

**Recommended fix**: Add standard security headers to the `_headers` file appropriate for the deployment target (Cloudflare Pages / Netlify).

Ref: quality review issue #10
